## Anti-slop update

- Update the vendored generic anti-slop plugin to upstream commit `c44ef22ca116d0ba62a3ff663a0bd13a3f3fa40b`.
- Enable checks for adjacent array filter/map passes, copied reduce accumulators, and missing blank lines between declarations and statement groups.
- Improve scoped and generic type-alias resolution, assertion safety comments, and shadowed-global detection. Generic aliases that conceal `unknown` now fail lint.
- Add end-to-end fixtures for the new rules and update existing examples for the spacing policy. The bundled Oxlint configuration applies these changes automatically when upgrading the release pin.
